name: Las Americas Premium Outlets
description: Las Americas Premium Outlets is San Diego's premier outlet shopping destination located near the U.S.-Mexico border, offering designer and brand-name merchandise at savings of 25% to 65% every day. With over 125 stores including Nike Factory Store, Coach, Michael Kors, Kate Spade New York, and more, this open-air center attracts shoppers from both sides of the border seeking exceptional value on premium brands.
demographics: Border region shoppers, tourists, international visitors from Mexico, value-conscious consumers
summary: San Diego's largest outlet center featuring 125+ premium brand stores near the U.S.-Mexico border with daily savings up to 65%.
